verdict.rationale: Better Auth documents a built-in, configurable rate limiter that prevents abuse. It applies stricter default rules on sensitive paths (e.g. /sign-in/email limited to 3 requests per 10 seconds) and tracks client IPs via a configurable header, which directly addresses brute-force attempts. Community users confirm rate limiting is built in. Bot detection and IP blocking appear only as a single homepage line, and nothing specifically targets credential stuffing. Missing for 10: documented bot detection/CAPTCHA mechanics, credential-stuffing defenses (breached-password checks, distributed-attack detection, account lockout), independent hands-on verification of the protections.
